summary.text: Whitfield Harrington Jr., an American Center Party candidate and Chicago pastor who previously worked in banking, insurance and financial services, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. Senate seat in Illinois to Juliana Stratton.
He described his campaign as an independent, centrist alternative focused on affordability and opportunity.

paragraphs.text: Harrington was born in Belzoni, Mississippi, the twentieth of 21 children, by his own account.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Delta State University in 2002.
His career has included work in banking, insurance and financial services, including operating his own insurance practice.
He moved to Chicago in 2013, serves as pastor of Prayer City of Chicago Church, and says he lives in Schaumburg, Illinois.
He received 1.6% of the vote to Juliana Stratton's 61.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
